rules: Line 1 of every .md/.tpl template is '<!-- ub-template: NAME v1 kind=KIND -->'; the engine removes it when rendering.
Isolated-call prompts (every prompts/*.md except GEN-HEADER) have line 2 'Do not load or invoke any skill; this prompt is the whole task.'
Placeholders are {{UPPER_SNAKE}}; every one is listed under placeholders. Templates are ASCII and never contain a dollar sign followed by an opening brace.
prompts/*.md: the engine also removes every other '<!-- ... -->' block after reading any ub-choices table in it.

ub-choices block: first line '<!-- ub-choices: PLACEHOLDER key=KEY_NAME', then rows 'KEY | text', then '-->'. PLACEHOLDER takes the text of the row whose KEY equals the engine value KEY_NAME; the text may contain placeholders.

host/*.md: the host reads the raw file (card task.template). Only the block between '<!-- ub-argument:begin -->' and '<!-- ub-argument:end -->' is filled by the engine and written to task.argument_file.
A line that consists only of one placeholder whose value is empty is removed; any other empty value renders as ''.
Every prompt ends with an OUTPUT RULE section whose last line is {{OUTPUT_RULE}}.

fill_rules.prompts: engine registry PLACEHOLDERS plus the job's item vars; an unknown name refuses the job
fill_rules.host: only the text between the ub-argument markers is filled (registry) and written to task.argument_file; the host reads the raw template
fill_rules.gates: gate_context names first, then registry placeholders; the result is written to gates/<G>.md and shown verbatim
fill_rules.docs: doc_mappings[NAME] for the docs the engine fills (a name outside the mapping makes the engine use its built-in text); the other docs are format references for render_arch.py and the engine's writers
